stem: In a circle, the chords $AB$ and $CD$ are equal in length. The inscribed angle $\angle AEB$ stands on the minor arc $AB$ and measures $({=p}x - {=q})^\circ$. The inscribed angle $\angle CFD$ stands on the minor arc $CD$ and measures ${=m}^\circ$. Find the value of $x$.
solution: Equal chords in the same circle cut off equal minor arcs, so arc $AB$ = arc $CD$.
Equal arcs give equal inscribed angles: ${=p}x - {=q} = {=m}$.
notes: Basic: one equation from equal chords/arcs -> equal inscribed angles, as in the book's Figure 1. Described in words; no figure needed.
